name: GeoGebra Math Apps
description: Offline GeoGebra Math Apps (graphing, geometry, 3D, CAS, scientific, suite) with WEB math keyboard; AI-driven via evalCommand.

zh.name: GeoGebra 数学应用
zh.description: 离线 GeoGebra 数学应用（绘图 / 几何 / 3D / CAS / 科学计算器 / 套件），含网页版数学键盘；AI 通过 evalCommand 驱动。

en.name: GeoGebra Math Apps
en.description: Offline GeoGebra Math Apps (graphing, geometry, 3D, CAS, scientific, suite) with the WEB math keyboard; AI-driven via evalCommand.

tools.name: ggb_eval
tools.description: Execute GeoGebra commands in the Math Apps panel (opens automatically). Use English GeoGebra syntax, ONE object per command, in dependency order. Examples: f(x)=sin(x); A=(1,2); c=Circle((0,0),3); SetColor(f,"Blue"). Switch app first with ggb_set_app when you need 3D/CAS/geometry. Returns per-command success and object names.

tools.name: ggb_clear
tools.description: Clear the GeoGebra construction (new blank worksheet).

tools.name: ggb_export_png
tools.description: Export the current GeoGebra view as a PNG shown to the user.

tools.name: ggb_set_app
tools.description: Switch the GeoGebra app: graphing | geometry | 3d | cas | scientific | suite.

tools.name: ggb_save
tools.description: Return the current construction as a base64 .ggb (for the user to download or for ggb_load).

tools.name: ggb_load
tools.description: Load a construction from a base64 .ggb string.

tools.name: ggb_keyboard
tools.description: Show the on-screen WEB math keyboard (tabs: 123 / f(x) / ABC / symbols).

tools.name: ggb_state
tools.description: List objects currently in the GeoGebra construction (name, type, definition).
